user.title: Connect to a Tapo H500
user.description: All traffic remains local. The TP-Link cloud password is required only for local media encryption.

data_description.poll_interval: How quickly activity reaches Home Assistant. This is the whole notification delay -- nothing arrives sooner than the next check. A check costs the hub about 40ms, so 2 seconds is comfortable and 1 is allowed. Changeable later under Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or authenticate with the H500.
error.no_cameras: The H500 reported no paired cameras.

data.keep_downloads: Downloaded clips to keep per camera
data.keep_rings: Doorbell presses to keep per camera

data_description.convert_mp4: MP4 plays in the browser; turn this off to keep the hub's original MPEG-TS.
data_description.keep_downloads: 0 keeps everything. Any other number prunes the oldest automatic downloads once a camera holds more than that. Manual downloads are never pruned.
data_description.poll_interval: The whole notification delay: nothing reaches Home Assistant sooner than the next check. About 40ms of hub time per check, so low values are cheap.
data_description.keep_rings: 0 treats presses like everything else. Any other number keeps that many of the newest presses whatever their age, so a busy afternoon of motion cannot evict the press that mattered.

faces.title: Name faces

layout.title: Camera layout
layout.description:
Give each camera a number for how close it is to your door: **0 for the one nearest the street**, higher as they get closer to the entrance. A gate camera might be 0 and the doorbell 1.

This is the one thing the integration cannot work out on its own — the hub reports no geometry. With it, a recognised person moving from one camera to another reads as *approaching* or *leaving* rather than just a list of places.

Leave every camera on the same number to turn this off; no direction is reported unless it is genuinely known.

abort.no_faces: The hub has not recognised any faces yet. It only reports one when its own face detection fires, and only for the period still held — try again after someone has been seen.
abort.one_camera: Only one camera is paired with this hub. A direction needs two places to be between.

storage_nearly_full.title: H500 storage is {used}% full
storage_nearly_full.description: The hub is about to start overwriting its oldest recordings to make room. Loop recording does not stop at full -- it discards the oldest footage silently. Download anything worth keeping, or format the hub storage once you have.

hub_unreachable.title: H500 is not responding
hub_unreachable.description: The hub has stopped answering, so nothing is being recorded to Home Assistant and every entity is showing its last known value. Check that it is powered and on the network. If the username is a TP-Link email rather than a local account, the hub refuses it with an error indistinguishable from being offline.

unnamed_face.title: A face the hub keeps seeing has no name
unnamed_face.description:
Face {face_id} has been seen {sightings} times on {cameras} and has not been named. Naming it makes every card, sensor and notification say who it is instead of a number — "Alice rang the Front Doorbell".

Name it under Configure → Name faces, where each face is listed with a link to its photograph, or with the Name this face button on the faces card.

{others} other face(s) are also waiting to be named.
